reviewScope.summary: Independent successor review of ProgressPal v1.5.1 release candidate 45aa399a8ee0b4d4ff866b2c1d285447f9d5fb98, root tree 9c798f018804723f1e18451a230a3ec89600629c and review payload tree 79b941de885acf834371ab13264aaa69d345a088. This candidate preserves the bounded accessibility repair introduced by 4f2f6d4402442c1cc01bb91be8bf0b42314bcc28 and adds the four release-version coherence corrections required after the native gate exposed incomplete v1.5.1 coupling. Review scope is limited to the accessibility hotfix, release-version identity, service-worker cache identity, directly affected regression evidence and whether those changes invalidate any previously accepted Epic E area. This review does not claim that the final native release gate has already passed.
evidence: Candidate identity: commit 45aa399a8ee0b4d4ff866b2c1d285447f9d5fb98; parent 0d990a25572ce8dfa86fc194391e152e70ca18ed; root tree 9c798f018804723f1e18451a230a3ec89600629c; review payload tree 79b941de885acf834371ab13264aaa69d345a088; application version 1.5.1; worktree clean at candidate freeze.

The product-bearing delta from failed v1.5.0 candidate ac0d7c8c88c5c67259889cb5c8c7e804770f2633, excluding release-review evidence, is bounded to ten files: package.json, package-lock.json, three lesson renderer files, lessonView.test.tsx, public/sw.js, databaseInitialization.test.ts, settings.spec.ts and serviceWorkerCache.test.ts.

The immutable v1.5.0 GitHub gate exposed a real axe scrollable-region-focusable violation in Programvareutvikling lesson preformatted regions. Every static lesson pre renderer capable of inheriting horizontal overflow now renders with tabIndex={0}.

The lesson DOM regression requires tabindex=0 on rendered pre elements and passed 17 of 17 targeted tests. The exact formerly failing Playwright axe/375 px lesson scenario passed one of one after the repair.

The first v1.5.1 native-gate attempt on evidence commit 3f4d2a3cc620a96a0cc17d16c1e03dae2bd619bb stopped at format:check because the newly created review JSON lacked its terminal newline. The formatting-only successor 0d990a25572ce8dfa86fc194391e152e70ca18ed changed only review evidence and did not change the reviewed product payload.

The second native-gate attempt on 0d990a25572ce8dfa86fc194391e152e70ca18ed passed review resolution, clean install, release-runner tests, dependency audit, lint, format, typecheck, production build and bundle-budget validation before the unit/integration suite exposed two deterministic version-coherence failures. The suite result was 129 of 131 files and 1989 of 1991 tests passing.

The two gate failures were classified separately: public/sw.js still declared progresspal-cache-v1.5.0 even though its explicit contract requires CACHE_VERSION to match package.json, while databaseInitialization.test.ts retained an obsolete literal expectation of application version 1.5.0 although currentApplicationVersion already derived 1.5.1 from package.json.

A complete tracked-version inventory before further mutation identified two additional active current-release literals: the persisted appVersion expectation in e2e/settings.spec.ts and the worker cache identity fixture in tests/lib/serviceWorkerCache.test.ts. Dependency versions such as lz-string 1.5.0 and historical documentation were classified separately and were not modified.

Candidate 45aa399a8ee0b4d4ff866b2c1d285447f9d5fb98 changes exactly those four active release-version coupling sites from 1.5.0 to 1.5.1: public/sw.js, tests/db/databaseInitialization.test.ts, e2e/settings.spec.ts and tests/lib/serviceWorkerCache.test.ts. The delta is exactly four insertions and four deletions.
Directly invalidated unit evidence is green: tests/architecture/serviceWorker.test.ts, tests/db/databaseInitialization.test.ts and tests/lib/serviceWorkerCache.test.ts passed 33 of 33 tests.

Directly affected browser evidence is green: all five settings tests and all five offline/service-worker tests passed, 10 of 10 total with one worker. The targeted E2E invocation also completed a production Vite build successfully before executing the browser tests.
Post-repair cheap static validation is green: git diff --check, ESLint with zero warnings, repository-wide Prettier check and TypeScript typecheck all passed.

The unrelated lz-string dependency remains correctly at version 1.5.0 with its matching 1.5.0 package identity. Only ProgressPal release identity is 1.5.1; no dependency version was changed as part of the release-coherence repair.
No database name, database schema, migration, Pyodide runtime, runtime worker, CSP, programme content, E2E timeout or release-runner limit changed in the successor repair.

The failed native-gate evidence for the unit/integration failure remains preserved at artifacts/release-evidence/2026-10-04T11-20-01-372Z-epic-e-v1-5-1-hotfix-pass-0.json with SHA-256 1B7C3FA623BB00F9D59917147BAF4A292A35B4727348C7B6904DCF59F00594B4.

The prior Epic E review remains historical evidence bound to its exact payload tree. Earlier v1.5.1 review states are preserved in Git history; the current hotfix review file is rebound only to payload 79b941de885acf834371ab13264aaa69d345a088. Repository review resolution selects only evidence bound to the exact current candidate payload.

adversarialFindings.description: Horizontally scrollable lesson preformatted regions could not receive keyboard focus, causing the immutable v1.5.0 release gate to fail axe's scrollable-region-focusable rule.
adversarialFindings.resolution: All static lesson pre render paths that can inherit horizontal overflow now render with tabIndex={0}. A real lesson DOM regression asserts the invariant, and the exact formerly failing Playwright axe/375 px scenario passes against the repaired production build.

adversarialFindings.description: Using static tabIndex={0} makes every affected preformatted region a keyboard stop even when that particular instance does not currently overflow.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted as a bounded keyboard-ergonomics trade-off. Horizontal overflow depends on viewport, content and font metrics, so deterministic focusability is more robust than conditionally adding focus only after overflow measurement. The behaviour remains semantically local to preformatted lesson content and can be revisited if keyboard-navigation feedback shows excessive tab stops.

adversarialFindings.description: The earlier Epic E release process has shown limited E2E runtime headroom across environments, but the current runner code uses a 14-minute managed Playwright ceiling and the failed immutable v1.5.0 run contained a genuine accessibility defect rather than evidence that the ceiling itself caused the release failure.
adversarialFindings.resolution: No timeout change is included in this hotfix. The successor must pass the repository-native release gate under the existing limit; a future timeout without a product-test failure should be investigated separately rather than hidden by increasing the ceiling pre-emptively.

adversarialFindings.description: The inherited Python-isolation evidence remains specific to the pinned Pyodide/runtime-worker/CSP implementation rather than proving arbitrary future runtime versions.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Inherited accepted risk from the exact parent review. The hotfix does not alter Pyodide, the worker, CSP or the runtime capability boundary, so the existing tripwire requirement remains applicable.

adversarialFindings.description: Programme #2 source governance still contains the previously disclosed stale protected-input mutation harness and frozen participant-baseline divergence.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Inherited bounded source-governance debt. None of the six hotfix files modifies Programme #2 authoring inputs, generated curriculum data or source-governance machinery.

adversarialFindings.description: Programvareutvikling remains Bokmal while substantial shared ProgressPal shell vocabulary remains English.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Inherited release-quality debt. The accessibility hotfix does not broaden scope into localization, avatar, selective-reset or other deferred presentation work.

adversarialFindings.description: The initial v1.5.1 successor changed the package application version without updating every active current-release consumer. The service-worker cache remained v1.5.0 and two current-version test oracles plus one service-worker fixture also retained v1.5.0.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Before further full-gate execution, all tracked version references were inventoried and classified by meaning. Only four genuine active release couplings were corrected: public/sw.js, databaseInitialization.test.ts, settings.spec.ts and serviceWorkerCache.test.ts. Targeted validation then passed 33 of 33 directly affected unit tests and 10 of 10 affected browser tests, with lint, format and typecheck also green.

retrospective.summary: Independent successor review finds the original v1.5.0 accessibility release blocker resolved and the subsequently exposed v1.5.1 release-version coherence defect resolved in candidate 45aa399a8ee0b4d4ff866b2c1d285447f9d5fb98 / payload 79b941de885acf834371ab13264aaa69d345a088. The final corrective tranche is four explicitly classified release-version couplings, with 33 of 33 directly affected unit tests and 10 of 10 affected browser tests passing, plus clean lint, format and typecheck. No schema, migration, runtime, CSP, curriculum, timeout or unrelated Epic E change is introduced. Remaining findings are bounded P3 accepted risks inherited from the prior review. Decision: proceed to the repository-native release gate. This review does not itself authorize push, merge, tag, release, deployment or production promotion.
